    https://alphafold.com/
    AlphaFold Protein Structure Database AlphaFold is an AI system developed by Google DeepMind that predicts a protein's 3D structure from its amino acid sequence. It regularly achieves accuracy competitive with experiment. Google DeepMind and EMBL's European Bioinformatics Institute (EMBL-EBI) have partnered to create AlphaFold DB to make these predictions freely available to the scientific ...

    https://deepmind.google/blog/alphafold-five-years-of-impact/
    Since 2020, AlphaFold has accelerated the pace of science and fueled a global wave of biological discovery — an achievement recognized with a Nobel Prize Five years ago, AlphaFold 2 solved the protein structure prediction problem, unlocking new avenues of biological research and providing our first major proof point that AI can be a powerful tool to advance science. [5] How AlphaFold Revolutionized Protein Structure Prediction
    https://big.ucdavis.edu/blog/how-alphafold-revolutionised-protein-structure-prediction
    Proteins are vital to all processes in life. AlphaFold is a deep-learning, artificial intelligence system developed by Google DeepMind that predicts a protein's 3D structure. AlphaFold has not replaced experimental biology, but it can fundamentally change the efficiency of it. It highlights an exciting future at the intersection of artificial intelligence and biology.

observations.content:
[1] AlphaFold - Wikipedia
    https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AlphaFold
    Announced on 8 May 2024, AlphaFold 3 was co-developed by Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs, both subsidiaries of Alphabet. AlphaFold 3 is not limited to proteins, as it can also predict the structures of protein complexes with DNA, RNA, post-translational modifications and selected ligands and ions. [35][15]

[2] AlphaFold — Google DeepMind
    https://deepmind.google/science/alphafold/
    AlphaFold has revealed millions of intricate 3D protein structures, and is helping scientists understand how all of life’s molecules interact.

[3] Alphabet (GOOGL) Disbands AlphaFold Team As DeepMind Pushes ...
    https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/alphabet-googl-disbands-alphafold-team-031617001.html?fr=sycsrp_catchall
    Alphabet's Google DeepMind has disbanded its dedicated AlphaFold team and reassigned researchers to work on the Gemini large language model and other scientific projects.

[4] Why Google DeepMind broke up the AlphaFold team
    https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/why-google-deepmind-broke-up-the-alphafold-team/
    Aug 7, 2026 · DeepMind began developing AlphaFold in 2018 to solve the “ protein folding problem,” or the task of predicting a protein’s 3D structure from just its amino acid sequence.

[5] A glimpse of the next generation of AlphaFold - Google DeepMind
    https://deepmind.google/blog/a-glimpse-of-the-next-generation-of-alphafold/
    Oct 31, 2023 · Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs have been working together to build the foundations of a more powerful AI model that expands coverage beyond just proteins to the full range of biologically-relevant molecules. Today we’re sharing an update on progress towards the next generation of AlphaFold.

args.query: AlphaFold paper Nature 2021 authors DeepMind developed AlphaFold

observations.content:
[1] AlphaFold - Wikipedia
    https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AlphaFold
    On 15 July 2021, the AlphaFold 2 paper was published in Nature as an advance access publication alongside open source software and a searchable database of species proteomes.[7][12][13] As of November 2025, the paper had been cited nearly 43,000 times.[14].

[2] AlphaFold — Google DeepMind
    https://deepmind.google/science/alphafold/
    Nature publishes AlphaFold’s detailed methodology in the paper “Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold” and DeepMind open sources the code along with 60 pages of supplemental information.

[3] Is Demis Hassabis Burning Bridges? Nobel Prize-Winning AlphaFold...
    https://eu.36kr.com/en/p/3917497947854722
    In 2018, DeepMind began developing AlphaFold, trying to enable AI to directly predict the 3D structure of a protein based on its sequence.In 2021, DeepMind published the AlphaFold 2 paper in *Nature* and opened the model code.

[4] GitHub - google-deepmind/alphafold: Open source code for...
    https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold
    This represents a work in progress and AlphaFold-Multimer isn't expected to be as stable as our monomer AlphaFold system. Read the guide for how to upgrade and update code. The technical note containing the models and inference procedure for an updated AlphaFold v2.3.0.

[5] Google DeepMind’s Groundbreaking AI for Protein Structure... | WIRED
    https://www.wired.com/story/alphafold-3-google-deepmind-ai-protein-structure-dna/
    AlphaFold, software developed by Google’s DeepMind AI unit to predict the 3D structure of proteins, has received a significant upgrade.In 2021, before DeepMind open sourced its creation, his team released an independent protein-structure prediction inspired by AlphaFold.

steps.note: **Google DeepMind** developed the **AlphaFold** protein structure prediction system. (Sources: [S2], [S3])
